agentResult.finalText:
The `amabie_doctor` call wasn't permitted, so I'll rely on the automatic verification (which re-runs the sealed checks for me) plus the direct runs above — both the sealed `checks/contract.cjs` and the extended quick suite pass.

**Everything works now.** All four contract violations are fixed; `node checks/contract.cjs` prints "contract checks passed" and `node run-tests.js` reports 9 passing.

## What was broken and what I changed

- **`src/storage.js` — tenant isolation and key collisions.** `key(tenant, id)` returned just `id`, so the same id in different tenants overwrote each other. Now it's `JSON.stringify([tenant, id])`, which is injective over string pairs — no collisions even when tenant/id contain `:`, `.`, or quote characters.
- **`src/replay.js` — replay dropped deletes.** It filtered to `op === 'put'`, so `open(exportJournal())` resurrected deleted pairs. Now it applies every event in order; repeated replays stay equivalent.
- **`src/api.js` — `batch` ignored delete events.** It called `rows.set(...)` directly, turning `{op:'delete'}` into a put of `undefined`. Batch now routes each event through the same `mutate` path as `put`/`remove`, preserving call order.
- **`src/api.js` — stale cache hits and misses.** The `get` memo map was never invalidated, so a cached miss (or hit) stayed wrong after any mutation. `apply` now evicts the affected key, covering all mutation paths (put, remove, batch, replay).

## What I preserved

- Public API shape: `open(history = [])` → `{put, remove, batch, get, exportJournal}`; module signatures `storage.key/create` and `replay(events, apply)`.
- `exportJournal` detachment (fresh array of fresh event copies) and journal-copy semantics were already correct and untouched.
- The sealed check `checks/contract.cjs` and `docs/CONTRACT.md` were not modified.

## Tests added

`run-tests.js` (the smoke suite) now has 9 targeted tests: tenant independence, delimiter/punctuation key collisions, cached-miss and cached-hit freshness across every mutation path, batch put+delete ordering, replay-with-deletions plus repeated-replay equivalence and history preservation, export detachment (tamper/truncate/push), and `open(history)` initial deletes.
